rule: RISK_MANAGEMENT section 4; params risk_rate=0.005, cluster_cap=0.005; old F-014; incident 16-43
summary: Size uses CURRENT equity, the cluster cap uses DAY-START equity, and both rates are 0.5 %: after any intraday equity gain a full-size trade on an empty book is refused CLUSTER_CAP_REJECT.
expected: One full-size trade on an empty book is admitted whenever the account is healthy.
actual: Day-start 1000 (cap 5.000): equity now 1003 -> risk 5.01375 rejected; 1010 -> 5.04525 rejected; 1000 and 995 pass. Coarse-step symbols pass only by rounding.
impact: Fewer trades after wins than after losses for the rest of the UTC day on BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP in the same direction; backtest and paper share the rule, so research statistics contain it; a confusing refusal for the owner.
evidence: live_risk_inputs.py:15-19 (two equities on purpose); sizing.py:82 allowed_risk = equity x risk_rate; portfolio.py:315-316 cluster_sum > cluster_cap_quote rejects; probe P2 output.
why_tests_miss: Tests use one equity for both bases or only the loss side (261108-voe regression).
recommendation: Owner decision: size on min(current, day-start) equity, or a cap margin above one risk unit, or cap and size on the same equity; needs a new parameter set / simulator version.
known_prior: partly: F-014 (cap equals one risk unit), 261108-voe (paper base mismatch, loss side)

summary: mark_placed/mark_open have no production caller (known R-21), and the recorded effect is understated: an exchange position is explained only by PLACED/OPEN rows, so with any open position every later placement is UNCERTAIN_ACCOUNT_STATE.
expected: With one position open and max_open_positions = 2, a second plan on another symbol is judged by the caps.
actual: Row RESERVED + exchange position -> open_positions_from_reservations returns None -> NO_TRADE; the margin of the filled plan is also counted twice (882.2 required instead of 442.2).
impact: The system is single-position in fact while R-21 is open; safe direction; plan 25-28 depends on PLACED/OPEN rows too.
evidence: reservations.py:292-306; risk_inputs.py:645-658 and the comment at 724; risk_reservations.py:463-497; reservation_release.py:146 is the only mark_placed caller; probe P3, P4.
why_tests_miss: Fakes and builder tests set PLACED/OPEN by hand; no composed test places a second plan after a fill.
recommendation: Do R-21 (PLACED at the acknowledgement, OPEN at the first fill) and add a composed two-symbol test.
known_prior: KNOWN:24-DEFERRED R-21 (effect recorded only as margin over-refusal)

summary: ACCOUNT_UPDATE events do not invalidate the equity source or the day-loss service; only fills and stream gaps do. D084 and two docstrings say they do.
expected: A funding fee, transfer, liquidation or ADL makes equity and day loss unknown until the next REST read.
actual: The router account_sink only persists position rows; the day loss stays known until the next scheduled backfill (at most 150 s; expiry 300 s).
impact: Bounded lag of the day loss by one backfill period (equity is re-read per placement); the documents describe a stronger guarantee. Mainnet severity LOW to MEDIUM.
why_tests_miss: No test sends an ACCOUNT_UPDATE and asserts an invalidation.
recommendation: Invalidate both from the account sink and trigger a backfill, or correct the documents.

summary: enforce_daily_state has no caller in the live process (known 25-15-F1): at DAILY_STOP resting entries are not cancelled and no daily alert is sent. New here: a code comment claims the placement path does it, and evaluate() consumes the one-shot alert marks for callers that send nothing.
expected: At DAILY_STOP resting entries of placed plans are cancelled and DAILY_STOP / DAILY_LOSS_WARNING alerts are sent once.
actual: Only new approvals and placements are blocked. A resting GTD LIMIT entry can fill after the latch; alerts_due is dropped by both callers of evaluate.
impact: Mainnet: a third entry can open after the 1 % stop; the owner is not told the day is stopped; after 25-28 the alert can still be lost when another caller latches first.
evidence: grep enforce_daily_state src: no caller; risk_inputs.py:558-560 comment; risk_inputs.py:627; day_risk_service.py:581-596.
reproduction: Search importers of src.execution.daily_stop; read LiveRiskInputProducer.open_day and _assemble.
why_tests_miss: tests/test_live_alerts_wiring.py:320 calls enforce_daily_state directly, not through the composition.
recommendation: Wire it (25-28) and make the alert-sent mark a write of the sender, not of evaluate.
known_prior: KNOWN:25-15-SUMMARY F1, 25-28-PLAN (not executed at the snapshot)

summary: A fill whose commission asset is not the quote asset (BNB fee payment) makes the day loss unknown for the rest of the UTC day; nothing checks the account fee-burn setting or names the cause.
expected: The setting is checked at start with a plain refusal, or the case is in the runbook.
actual: One BNB commission component -> loss None (DAILY_LOSS_UNKNOWN) until 00:00 UTC; last_error_type stays None.
impact: Silent NO_TRADE for the rest of each day after the first fill if the mainnet account pays fees in BNB; fail closed. Mainnet severity LOW to MEDIUM (availability).
evidence: daily_loss.py:327-328; day_risk_service.py:185-193, 221-229; grep feeBurn in src is empty; probe P5 last line.
why_tests_miss: The foreign-asset test asserts the designed unknown result; the operator consequence is untested.
recommendation: Read the fee-burn status at start (refuse or alert), or add a named blocked reason and a RUNBOOK line.
